tools.name: start_brokerage_enquiry
tools.description: Open the Brokeret "Get Started" enquiry form so a brokerage can request a demo or quote. This form collects company and project details and requires human verification, so it is presented to the user rather than submitted automatically.

tools.name: subscribe_newsletter
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to the Brokeret newsletter for product updates. Use when a person wants to receive Brokeret news or updates by email.

name.description: Optional full name of the subscriber.
